## Verdicts

### V1 claude:C1 Capacity holds to minus 15 C
Held, nothing found against it in 6 searches. The study says so. Sources: [Study](https://example.org/study).

### V2 codex:C1 Cold units work
Weakened. The field data is from milder winters. Sources: [Field data](https://example.net/field).

## The case against

Old ducts cut delivered heat [DOE](https://www.energy.gov/energysaver/heat-pump-systems).

## Pre-mortem

Reasoning, not evidence. 1. Backup heat runs more than modelled (undoes claude:C2).

## Methods and limits

8 searches, 5 pages read. Not examined: claude:C2, for time.
